CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
M463J SUB MASTER MODULE
DIRECT Output and MON·nOR Output
The DIRECT output appears at pins 16/T. An additional isolated
output is provided at pins 17/U. The latter output may be
utilized as
metering and/or monitor takeoff
Care should be
taken to restr ict loading of this output to 5k ohms or higher.
Master Outputs and PAN Control
left and
right MASTER output are also being fed by the 8-109F
output signal. They are routed via PAN switch SWI and PAN control
R29 to R32, followed by two MASTER ASSIGNMENT SWITCHES SW5 and
SW6. The master outputs are connected to the appropriate module
output termina ls via summ ing network resistors to be combined
with feeds from other submaster mixing channels.
Auxiliary Ou tputs
In addition,
SOLO output is available via SW7, to allow
selective monitoring of the particular submaster channel
Other
feeds originating from the 8-109F amplifier are supplied to the
POST FADE RS, FB and PA channels.
PRE/POST Selector Switches and Level Controls
PRE/POST selection of the RS, FB and PA channels is facilitated
by switches SW2, SW3 and SW4 respectively; each switch is followed
by its associated level control. The outputs of the level
controls are fed to the summing outputs via individual assignment
switches
Following the assignment switches, these outputs are
fed to their appropriate mixing "buses via summing resistors.
Control Functions
dc control contact closure is provided through operation of
either one of the MASTER ASSIGNMENT switches SW5 or SW6.
further control contact is available on the SOLO switch SW7.
Power Supply Decoupling
An active power supply decoupling network consisting of Q9 ps
through Q14 provides isolation between the module and the ±25
BS
voJt supply rails
Transistors Q13 and Q14 monitor the supply
current. In the event of excessive power supply demands, such
as from component failure or amplifier overdrive the current
flow ing through Qll and Q12 will be limited.
